mapper.sql: id, parent_id, name, path, component, perms, type, icon, sort, visible, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.type, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, name, path, component, perms, type, icon, sort, visible, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0), #{name}, #{path}, #{component}, #{perms}, #{type}, #{icon}, COALESCE(#{sort}, 0), COALESCE(#{visible}, 1), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
